turns.text: Hi, I need to change the delivery address. The parcel should not go to the address I used at checkout.
Hello, I can help with a delivery address change. First, please send me the order number (it starts with SC- followed by four digits) and the email address you used when you placed the order.
The order is SC-3360, the email is nora.blake@example.com, and the new address is Str. Exemplu 22, Sibiu.

Thank you, Nora. I checked order SC-3360, and it has already shipped. Under our policy, the delivery address can only change before the order ships, so I can't change it. I have passed your request to a colleague, who will take over and look at it with you. You can follow the parcel with this tracking link: https://curier.example/track/SC3360

rule.ro: Adresa de livrare se poate schimba până la expedierea comenzii. Schimbarea trebuie aprobată de echipă.
rule.en: The delivery address can change until the order ships. Staff must approve the change.

input.summary: Customer Nora Blake (nora.blake@example.com) asked to change the delivery address on order SC-3360 to Str. Exemplu 22, Sibiu. The order has already shipped, so the policy does not allow the change through the shop. Customer has not asked for a person.
